app.title: Economii
app.tagline: Your savings, goals and money owed to you — kept in this browser only.
app.fromSheet: Coming from the spreadsheet? Run scripts/import_xlsx.py on it to get a backup file.

backup.replaceConfirm: Replace all current data with this backup?
backup.invalid: This file isn't an Economii backup.

rate.updated: ECB rate, updated {{date}}. Click to refresh.
rate.failed: Couldn't refresh — using the last known rate

history.title: History
history.subtitle: End of each month, after taking out the ING salary savings
history.empty: Record your first month to see the chart.

table.unrecorded: Not recorded for this month: using today's de primit. Type the real amount to fix it.
table.hintFormula: Balance = in accounts − ING salary savings. Real total = balance + de primit; Change compares real totals.
table.hintNoIng: Months with “—” under ING were entered with the ING part already taken out.
table.hintUnrecorded: * De primit wasn't tracked per month in the sheet, so those months show today's total (greyed); type the real amount to make them exact.

goals.title: Goals
goals.subtitle: What's still left to pay
goals.name: Goal name
goals.hint: Tick items once paid. Use a negative amount for money you get towards it (e.g. −2100 from parents).
goals.templateHint: Creates a new goal with the same items, all unpaid — handy for planning the next one.

plan.title: Salary split
plan.subtitle: How saved salaries are spread across accounts
plan.hint: On ING = total saved − what the euros really cost, each exchange at its own rate. It's subtracted from your accounts total when you record a month.
plan.mismatch_one: {{salaries}} salaries saved, but {{count}} monthly investment logged.
plan.mismatch_other: {{salaries}} salaries saved, but {{count}} monthly investments logged.

sync.local: Saved in this browser only. Export a backup regularly.
sync.synced: Synced to your claude.ai account — same data on all your devices.
sync.error: Can't reach your claude.ai account right now. Changes are kept in this browser.

exchange.title: Exchanges
exchange.importedHint: Imported from the spreadsheet: the date and real rate aren't known (the sheet used 5). Edit the rate if you know it.
